import { computed, shallowRef, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { defaultRangeExtractor, useVirtualizer, type Range } from '@tanstack/vue-virtual';
import { makeSortableList } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import NoteRow from './NoteRow.vue';
import { makeNotes } from './notes';

const OVERSCAN = 6;
const notes = shallowRef(makeNotes(5_000));

// The scroller is the sortable list: the library sorts it and auto-scrolls it.
const scrollRef = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('scroll');
const { items, activeIndex, captureLayout } = makeSortableList(scrollRef, { items: notes });

// One computed that reads the draft once: TanStack memoizes the measurements and the range
// on `getItemKey` and `rangeExtractor`, so they must be new functions after every reorder.
const virtualizer = useVirtualizer(
  computed(() => {
    const arr = items.value;
    const pin = activeIndex.value;
    return {
      count: arr.length,
      getScrollElement: () => scrollRef.value,
      // A guess: every row is measured once it renders (`measureElement` below).
      estimateSize: () => 92,
      overscan: OVERSCAN,
      getItemKey: (index: number) => arr[index]!.id,
      // The dragged row stays mounted, however far you scroll from it.
      rangeExtractor: (range: Range) => {
        const indexes = defaultRangeExtractor(range);
        return pin < 0 || indexes.includes(pin) ? indexes : [...indexes, pin].sort((a, b) => a - b);
      },
      // Measurements land after the library's animation pass: animate them too.
      onChange: () => captureLayout(),
    };
  }),
);
const rows = computed(() => virtualizer.value.getVirtualItems());
const measure = (el: unknown) => virtualizer.value.measureElement(el as HTMLElement | null);

/** The dragged row is out of the range the virtualizer would render: only the pin keeps it. */
const pinned = computed(() => {
  const range = virtualizer.value.range;
  const pin = activeIndex.value;
  return pin >= 0 && !!range && (pin < range.startIndex - OVERSCAN || pin > range.endIndex + OVERSCAN);
});
</script>

<template>

    <header>
      <strong>Notes</strong>
      <span class="pin" :class="{ on: pinned }">row {{ activeIndex + 1 }} pinned</span>
      <span class="meta">{{ notes.length.toLocaleString('en') }} notes · {{ rows.length }} in the DOM</span>
    </header>
    <div ref="scroll" class="scroller">
      <div class="sizer" :style="{ height: `${virtualizer.getTotalSize()}px` }">
        <!-- Positioned one by one, keyed by id: the virtualizer measures each of them. -->
        <div
          v-for="row in rows"
          :key="(row.key as string)"
          :ref="measure"
          :data-index="row.index"
          class="slot"

import { shallowRef, type ShallowRef } from 'vue';

export interface Card {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  /** Every third card has a note: the cards differ in height. */
  note?: string;
  points: number;
}

export interface Column {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  color: string;
  /** A shallowRef per column: its list writes the drops into it, and 1,000 cards get no deep proxies. */
  cards: ShallowRef<Card[]>;
}

const TITLES = ['Sync the calendar', 'Fix the login redirect', 'Export to CSV', 'Onboarding emails', 'Search by tag', 'Retry failed uploads'];
const NOTES = ['Blocked by the API review', 'Needs a design pass', 'Customer request'];

const makeCards = (prefix: string, count: number, shift: number): Card[] =>
  Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => ({
    id: `${prefix}-${i + 1}`,
    title: TITLES[(i + shift) % TITLES.length]!,
    note: i % 3 === 1 ? NOTES[(i + shift) % NOTES.length] : undefined,
    points: [1, 2, 3, 5, 8][(i + shift) % 5]!,
  }));

export const makeColumns = (perColumn: number): Column[] => [
  { id: 'todo', title: 'To do', color: '#3b82f6', cards: shallowRef(makeCards('TD', perColumn, 0)) },
  { id: 'doing', title: 'In progress', color: '#f59e0b', cards: shallowRef(makeCards('IP', perColumn, 2)) },
  { id: 'done', title: 'Done', color: '#42b883', cards: shallowRef(makeCards('DN', perColumn, 4)) },
];

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { defaultRangeExtractor, useVirtualizer, type Range } from '@tanstack/vue-virtual';
import { makeSortableList } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import CardView from './Card.vue';
import type { Column } from './cards';

const props = defineProps<{ column: Column }>();
/** The space under each card, inside its slot (`.slot` below). */
const GAP = 8;

const scrollRef = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('scroll');
const { items, activeIndex, activeSize, captureLayout, isOver } = makeSortableList(scrollRef, {
  id: props.column.id,
  items: props.column.cards,
  group: 'board',
});

const virtualizer = useVirtualizer(
  computed(() => {
    const arr = items.value;
    const pin = activeIndex.value;
    const size = activeSize.value;
    return {
      count: arr.length,
      getScrollElement: () => scrollRef.value,
      // A card coming from another column gets its real height before it is measured.
      estimateSize: (index: number) => (index === pin && size ? size.height + GAP : 72),
      overscan: 6,
      getItemKey: (index: number) => arr[index]!.id,
      rangeExtractor: (range: Range) => {
        const indexes = defaultRangeExtractor(range);
        return pin < 0 || indexes.includes(pin) ? indexes : [...indexes, pin].sort((a, b) => a - b);
      },
      onChange: () => captureLayout(),
    };
  }),
);
const rows = computed(() => virtualizer.value.getVirtualItems());
const measure = (el: unknown) => virtualizer.value.measureElement(el as HTMLElement | null);
</script>

<template>
  <section class="column" :class="{ over: isOver }">
    <h3>
      <span class="dot" :style="{ background: column.color }" />
      {{ column.title }}
      <span class="count">{{ items.length.toLocaleString('en') }}</span>
    </h3>
    <div ref="scroll" class="scroller">
      <div class="sizer" :style="{ height: `${virtualizer.getTotalSize()}px` }">
        <div
          v-for="row in rows"
          :key="(row.key as string)"
          :ref="measure"
          :data-index="row.index"
          class="slot"
          :style="{ transform: `translateY(${row.start}px)`, paddingBottom: `${GAP}px` }"
        >
          <CardView :card="items[row.index]!" />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
</template>
